item.title: Night temperatures drop sharply after spell of rain in Delhi, air quality sees slight improvement

item.title: Indian national among 4 dead in shooting linked to family dispute in US
item.description: An Indian national was among the victims of a shooting incident linked to an alleged family dispute in the US state of Georgia, according to the Indian mission in Atlanta. item.description: BATOTE: The Jammu-Srinagar National Highway (NH44) remains closed for the second consecutive day due to slippery road conditions.
